resources.string: FLAC replaces each WAV once the server has it: about half the space.
JPEGs stay as they are: every app can show them.
JPEG XL replaces each JPEG once the server has it, a fifth smaller, and the JPEG goes to the trash. Only this app can show JPEG XL.
The server keeps recordings as FLAC and photos as JPEG XL, from which the very same WAV or JPEG comes back.
